newsitem.title: USA: Sioux City cattle close $2.00 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux City cattle close $2.00 lower - USDA.

text.p: Compared to last week, slaughter steers and heifers $2.00 lower. Trade moderately active. - USDA

Slaughter Steers: Choice 2-3, drug free 1175-1250 lbs 66.75-67.00. Choice 2-3, 1150-1375 lbs 64.00-64.85. Select and Choice 2-3, 1075-1275 lbs 63.00-64.00. Select 60.00-63.00. Several loads returning to the feedlot 1050-1125 lbs 65.00-67.10.

Slaughter Heifers: Choice 2-3, drug free 1150-1225 lbs 67.00-67.10. Choice 2-3, 1075-1250 lbs 63.50-64.00. Select and Choice 2-3, 1050-1200 lbs 62.50-63.50. Select 60.00-62.50. Returning to the feedlot 1000-1050 lbs 64.00-65.35.
